_about: Hand-labelled question sequences for the stuck check (S3). Each case is one map's latest questions, oldest first; a question's conversation tells conversations apart, `window` marks one asked in the floating window. `expected.stuck` is the label; when stuck, `kind` is the expected kind and `topic` a word the named topic should contain (empty when no topic fits).
